defect: Pahang's Penyata Prestasi Kewangan prints THREE spending lines: Perbelanjaan Mengurus, Perbelanjaan Pembangunan and Perbelanjaan Bekalan Air. The water-supply line was extracted only under its spec-local code (prestasi_kewangan.perbelanjaan_bekalan_air), so the conformed panel lacked it and opex + devex fell short of the printed JUMLAH PERBELANJAAN by exactly that line.
diagnosis: Page-proved 2026-11-04 from the archived volumes (qa/evidence/): FY2016 CMD.37.2017.pdf p51 (J4.31): 629.27 + 91.66 + 89.95 = 810.88; FY2017 CMD.38.2018.pdf p51: 613.91 + 98.63 + 55.66 = 768.20; FY2021 CMD.46.2022.pdf p32: the text states the total covers mengurus, pembangunan and bekalan air (RM931.11 juta). FY2022 (CMD.43.2023.pdf) awaits its archived copy.
why_unfixed: Fixed in code 2026-11-04: table_catalog conforms it as expenditure_water_supply and N2 adds it; takes effect when states-extract.yml re-extracts (the conformed code is set at extraction).
impact_on_data: No figure is wrong. expenditure_total (as printed) is correct and is what core/gap_need_vs_money uses; do not derive Pahang's total as opex + devex.

impact_on_data: state_gov.debt.total for Pahang FY2020-2021 is understated in core until re-extraction.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: The root fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) was implemented and DELIBERATELY REVERTED: it moved roughly 2,000 rows across all 13 states, raised the refusal count, and degraded the frozen Selangor regression.  It needs its own pass with the column clustering retuned alongside it.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.
